name: COMP_016
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (79%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (20%) stays in the 90% conformal set, with six high-risk left regions.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 79%, Invasive 20%, InSitu 1% [F1] | Favors benign; 20% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot rule out invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 62nd OOD percentile [F6] | Typical image quality; not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models pick same class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 2/5 Invasive [F5] | Two closest neighbors are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.65); pulls against invasive (-0.62) [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical TIL score (0.07; +0.44) [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (1.01); pushes toward invasive (+0.39) [F4] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (0.19) pushes toward invasive (+0.33) · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.18); spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk left regions (0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9; 92%–100% risk) contain focal invasion diluted by benign right regions.
- Closest neighbors (BACH_0317 91%, BACH_0273 89%) are Invasive, and three surgical margins score positive [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 5**: Inspect left hotspot (93%–100% risk) for stromal invasion versus low benign stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 8, 9**: Check flagged medial (645 µm), inferior (430 µm), and superior (323 µm) margins.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Confirm benign tubule formation on the right half (0% invasive risk).
